## ✅ Checklist Before Merge
- [ ] Code compiles (`mvn clean install` runs without error)
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files committed
- [ ] Meaningful commit messages (Conventional Commits format)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for new functionality
- [ ] Tested locally (backend + frontend working)
- [ ] PR targets the correct branch (`dev`, not `master`)
- [ ] Branch name follows naming convention (`feature/`, `bugfix/`, etc.)
